title: The Spiraling Where Roots Begin Remembering Sky

features.name: the ascending spiral
features.desc-on-touch: a path of roots and light braided upward, each turn showing you something that looks like sky but tastes like earth

features.name: roots with eyes opening upward
features.desc-on-touch: what grew in darkness is learning that light was always there, just far away and patient, and now it remembers being young in that knowledge

features.name: the doubling point
features.desc-on-touch: here below and above are learning each other's names; the tree that stands above reflects through into the root-dark below, and both are true at once

features.name: fields becoming roots becoming fields
features.desc-on-touch: painted blocks of light and shadow that rearrange themselves as you watch, unable to decide whether they are grown things or remembered landscape

features.name: the memory at the turn
features.desc-on-touch: at this point in the spiral where everything is about to change, something tender and concrete rests, waiting to be read

inscription: the roots begin to remember they were once reaching upward, and the sky learns what it dropped to become rain

reverie.title: REVERIE — the spiral at the turn
narr: you stand in the fork where the root lifts upward,
and she touches the place where light first meets
what grew in darkness. the tree holds both of you
in the moment before it chooses which way to grow.
you are breathing the same air as the tree is,
and nothing needs naming yet; everything is turning.

exits.label: spiraling back down to the deepest stone
upward where the roots learn names for sky
toward the place where roots and light trade positions
